messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran a 4-GPU channel sweep (LL128) on rr/large-64k today, saw intermittent 20-60ms stall spikes during KV cache refill windows. Heatmap uploaded: https://internal/redwood/perf/heatmaps/1777771111.png

marta: link works. is this with channel_count=4 or dynamic?

alex: channel_count=4 pinned, algo=LL128, proto=nvfuser (we used the new proto flag). Repro on both 1.2.0 and 1.2.1 builds but only when KV miss rate > 15%.

cheng: do you have profiler timeline? which stage? allreduce/accumulate?

alex: attach: profiling gist -> shows peaks aligning with `allreduce` start/end. snippet:
```
Step 42: allreduce 1.8ms -> 23.4ms
Kernel overlap: compute stalls ~18ms
KV refill spikes @ step 42-46
```

samir: hmm could be channel contention + buffer copy synchronous path. any NCCL env vars set? `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` etc?

alex: we set `NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=PARALLEL`, `NCCL_ALGO=LL128`, `NCCL_PROTO=SIMPLE`. Tried `NCCL_PROTO=LL` — spikes reduced but throughput drop overall.

lia: did you try reducing `channel_count` to 2? previous runs showed smoother overlap but worse steady-state.

alex: yes, channel_count=2 reduces max stall to ~8ms but avg throughput down 12%. Putting this in the heatmap: results/1777771111.csv

marta: can you run one with `CU_FRONTEND_BATCH_SIZE` lowered? maybe batching heuristics + KV refill timing create bursty comm.

alex: queued a run (job id perf-1777). Also adding per-GPU nvprof output. If anyone wants to triage: open the heatmap and look at GPU1 timeline — KV cache refill aligns with allreduce windows.

infra-bot: perf job perf-1777 started on pool-gpu-p4. ETA 45m :rocket:

cheng: next steps: (1) try proto=LL with channel_count=3, (2) add async memcpy path for KV refill, (3) add microbench for small allreduce latency under KV refill. I'll try 1 and 3.

samir: sounds good. Also file a perf-regression ticket referencing this thread. I'll draft it.

alex: created ticket PERF-8321, linked the heatmap and csv. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lia: ping when 1777 finishes, I'll run canary with 1.2.2-rc with kernel fallback patch.

alex: will do.
